# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Photo Niv
A beginner photographer specializing in a diverse range of personal and professional photography services including portraits, family shoots, marriage proposals, modeling portfolios, and branding/headshots. The brand aims for a modern and clean aesthetic, suggesting a fresh, contemporary visual identity that appeals to individuals and families seeking polished, heartfelt photography experiences.

## Services/Products
- פורטרטים
- צילומי משפחה
- הצעות נישואין
- בוקים
- תדמית

## Target Audience
- זוגות מתחתנים
- לקוחות עסקיים
- בוקים זוגות משפחה ילדים פורטרטים תדמית

## Industry
Photography
